execution_owner: Existing approved runner; use dstack for separately authorized resource lifecycle, SGLang/compatible server gateway for packet routing.

recipes.work: Bounded code tasks with an executable acceptance validator
recipes.already_observed: Run 3 provides historical calibration on Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-FP8; it is not a general coding-agent deployment
recipes.runtime_policy: Keep the successful environment digests until replacement is qualified; newest tags are change signals only
recipes.terminal: Return code and acceptance receipts; preserve all failures; reconcile execution before retrying an unknown remote state

recipes.work: Multi-turn sessions with repeated prefixes, bounded tool work and long context
recipes.test: Compare no cache, HBM cache and offloaded cache on the same traces and end-to-end acceptance; include queue and cold-load penalties
recipes.isolation: Cache key binds tenant, workload, model/tokenizer/revision and compatible runtime/layout; placement only accepts a qualified supplied savings estimate
recipes.terminal: Request acceptance and cache-cost receipts, no arbitrary command execution from a retrieved trace

recipes.work: Native extraction and indexing first; selectively escalate layout/semantic tasks that require inference
recipes.test: Schema validity, source/page attribution, reference-field agreement and explicit abstention; retain readable text without OCR
recipes.terminal: Usable structured corpus and per-source validation receipts; remote data allowed only by policy

lifecycle_contract.new_lease: Use observed minimum reservation and allocation size, not just per-GPU hourly advertisement
lifecycle_contract.fleet_floor: Zero minimum nodes for an on-demand fleet; explicitly set idle_duration and inspect resulting plan
lifecycle_contract.retention: Model storage and GPU idle cost independently; delete/release confirmation is a required terminal observation
lifecycle_contract.spend: Predicted cost is not a provider-enforced spending cap; existing account/policy executor must enforce its authority
lifecycle_contract.retry: Query operation status before retrying a request with unknown remote execution; preserve idempotency scope
